Subject: Spring Special offer for ConceptDraw software


 Dear Tony,
Thank you for choosing ConceptDraw Software!

ConceptDraw MINDNMAP 5 Pro can help you to easily develop ideas and then present any information in a clear visual way. This tool is very helpful when creating complicated projects with many relations, presenting your ideas to others or simply organizing your daily activities.
ConceptDraw Project 4 is designed to help you in planning your projects no matter what field you are engaged in. This tool will support you when organizing new projects and help to achieve successful results in a planned and most effective way.
